thread:
nina: Quick thread: finalize convo API decision for compliance customers. Key constraints: immutable system role, schema enforcement for output, minimal payload for mobile SDKs.
blake: For mobile, payload size matters. Suggest a `compact` boolean that collapses metadata in transit. Server expands into normal `messages`.
tony: Compliance asks look like: 1) system lock with org policy; 2) immutable audit trail; 3) ability to request signed transcript exports. We'll need an export API.
rita: Structured output flow: add `schema` param and `validate=true`. If model fails validation, call back to model with error hints up to N retries, then return structured error with `validation_failures`.
ina: Roles: canonicalize `system`, `user`, `assistant`. We also need to document role precedence for overrides. Propose: org system > request system > user.
blake: Also add `system_injection_mode`: `prepend|replace|append` to control how server applies org-level system messages. Default `prepend`.
rita: Edgecases: When using function calling, schema validation should happen on the function output or model text? We should validate function responses if the function is the canonical structured producer.
ina: Implementation owners? Blake + Tony for infra, Rita for schema + E2E tests. I'll add to roadmap and file tickets.
